name: application-lead-score-meter
title: Lead Score Meter
description: 0-100 lead score gauge with three qualitative color bands (Cold/Warm/Hot) and a marker positioned at the current score, plus a derived status badge.
useWhen: A CRM or sales tool needs to show a computed fit/intent score against qualitative thresholds, not just a raw number.
Users benefit from an at-a-glance temperature label (Cold/Warm/Hot) alongside the precise numeric score.
The scoring bands are fixed and known in advance, unlike a continuous unbounded metric.
avoidWhen: The underlying value isn't bounded to a fixed 0-100 range — use a different chart form for open-ended metrics.
You need to compare a value against a single target/threshold rather than qualitative zones — use bullet-chart instead.
Precision matters more than the qualitative label — a plain stat-tile number may be clearer than a banded gauge.
responsiveBehavior: The meter is a fixed w-72 block that fills its container's available width up to that cap at all breakpoints.
accessibility: The numeric score is always shown as text alongside the visual gauge, not conveyed by marker position alone.
The status badge pairs a colored dot with a text label ('Hot lead — high fit and intent'), so temperature is never color-only.
Band labels (Cold/Warm/Hot) are always-visible text beneath the gauge, not tooltips or hover-only content.

variants.title: Hot lead
variants.description: Score of 78 with the marker positioned in the Hot band and a matching status badge.
accessibility: The marker's left offset is computed from the numeric score, keeping the visual and textual values in sync.

variants.title: Hot lead (Dark)
variants.description: Hot lead score state adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Band and badge colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.

variants.title: Cold lead
variants.description: Score of 22 with the marker in the Cold band and a matching neutral status badge.
accessibility: Cold state uses neutral gray rather than a warning color, since a cold lead isn't itself an error condition.

variants.title: Cold lead (Dark)
variants.description: Cold lead score state adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Neutral badge colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
